extraction.notes: Q3 2026 (three months ended Sep 30, 2026) reconciliation taken from the FFO page (seq 7, printed p.5); the same figures appear again at seq 17 (p.6) and in the definitions reconciliation at seq 9 (p.7), where the FFO section lists the impairment line before the gain on sale (order differs; values identical). Casualty and investment-loss lines show an em dash for the current quarter and are recorded as 0. The land development impairment ($86,404K) is placed in re_impairment since it sits in the FFO section; the company does not describe whether the land is depreciable, so this categorization is a judgment. Arithmetic checks: FFO 176,352; Core FFO 178,027; Core AFFO 147,689. Per-share check: 176,352/103,826=1.70; 178,027/103,826=1.71; 147,689/103,826=1.42. Recurring capex is subtracted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
